intro.zh:
實作一個 AVL 樹，支援插入、刪除與查詢，並與未平衡的二元搜尋樹比較效能。

  • 請附上測試程式與執行結果
  • 報告以 PDF 繳交
intro.en:
Implement an AVL tree with insert, delete and search, and compare its performance with an unbalanced binary search tree.

  • Include your tests and their output
  • Submit the report as a PDF

text.zh: 草稿：目前完成插入與旋轉，刪除還在寫。
text.en: Draft: insertion and rotations done, deletion still in progress.

summary.zh:
本課程介紹常用的資料結構與其分析方法，著重於實作與效能比較。

  • 陣列、串列、堆疊與佇列
  • 樹、平衡樹與堆積
  • 圖與最短路徑

教科書：Data Structures and Algorithms in C++，作業與講義皆在 Moodle 公告。
summary.en:
An introduction to the common data structures and how to analyse them, with an emphasis on implementation and measuring performance.

  • Arrays, lists, stacks and queues
  • Trees, balanced trees and heaps
  • Graphs and shortest paths

Textbook: Data Structures and Algorithms in C++. Homework and slides are posted on Moodle.

message.zh: 本週起助教時間改為每週三 15:30–17:00，地點 TR-411。
message.en: From this week, TA office hours are Wednesdays 15:30–17:00 in TR-411.

message.zh:
期中考將於 11 月 4 日上課時間舉行，地點 TR-313。

  1. 範圍：第 1–7 章
  2. 可攜帶一張 A4 手寫筆記

考古題請見課程頁面。
message.en:
The midterm is on November 4 in class time, room TR-313.

  1. Scope: chapters 1–7
  2. One handwritten A4 sheet allowed

Past papers are on the course page.

intro.zh: 作業與課程內容的問題請在這裡發問。
intro.en: Ask about homework and course content here.

message.zh: 發問前請先搜尋是否有人問過，並在標題寫明作業編號。
message.en: Search before you ask, and put the homework number in the title.

title.zh: 作業三：刪除節點後要如何重新平衡？
title.en: Homework 3: how do we rebalance after a deletion?

message.zh: 刪除有兩個子節點的節點時，要用前驅還是後繼取代？兩種寫法的旋轉次數會不同嗎？
message.en: When deleting a node with two children, should we replace it with its predecessor or its successor? Does the number of rotations differ?

message.zh: 兩種都可以，請在報告中說明你的選擇。旋轉次數最多都是 O(log n)。
message.en: Either is fine; explain your choice in the report. Both need at most O(log n) rotations.

message.zh: 請問測試資料需要包含重複的鍵值嗎？
message.en: Do the test cases need to include duplicate keys?

message.zh: 不需要，可以假設鍵值都不重複。
message.en: No, you may assume every key is distinct.

title.zh: 期中考可以帶計算機嗎？
title.en: Can we bring a calculator to the midterm?

message.zh: 想確認期中考是否可以使用計算機。
message.en: Is a calculator allowed in the midterm?

message.zh: 不需要，考題不會用到計算機。
message.en: You won't need one; no question calls for it.

description.zh: 研究興趣為演算法與資料庫系統。
description.en: Research interests: algorithms and database systems.

intro.zh:
以小組為單位，在 xv6 中實作 多層回饋佇列 排程器，並量測不同工作負載下的回應時間。

每組繳交一份報告與程式碼壓縮檔。
intro.en:
In your lab group, implement a multi-level feedback queue scheduler in xv6 and measure response times under different workloads.

One report and one source archive per group.

message.zh: 請在第一次實驗前安裝 Ubuntu 24.04 虛擬機，步驟請見附件。
message.en: Please install an Ubuntu 24.04 virtual machine before the first lab. The steps are attached.
